extraction: Raw VizieR asu-tsv response, unmodified. Identifier verified: response echoes '#Name: J/ApJS/182/12'. One row per Chandra ObsID, so clusters with several observations appear more than once (320 rows / 239 clusters).
note: ACCEPT sample summary table (Cavagnolo et al. 2009). Used here to (a) confirm cluster identities by RA/Dec - in particular that ACCEPT's 'Abell 1063S' at 22 48 44.294 -44 31 48.37, z=0.3540, SimbadName 'ACO S 1063' is indeed Abell S1063 = RXC J2248.7-4431 - and (b) supply the global <kT>. *** CORE-EXCISION STATUS OF <kT> IS NOT DOCUMENTED *** : the published ReadMe defines column <kT> only as 'Average cluster temperature', with no aperture and no statement about whether the core was excised. It should therefore NOT be quoted as a core-excised temperature. The <kT> values for the targets are: Abell 1063S 11.96, Abell 2029 7.38, Abell 2744 9.18, MACS J0717.5+3745 10.50, MACS J1149.5+2223 8.40 keV.
